title: Judging the Judges: A Systematic Study of Position Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge
authors_zh: Lin Shi, Chiyu Ma, Wenhua Liang, Xingjian Diao, Weicheng Ma, Soroush Vosoughi
paper_type_zh: LLM judge 位置偏差系统审计论文
best_for_zh: 需要选择、审计或校准自动评测 judge 的研究者。
one_line: Accepted systematic audit of position bias with public proceedings materials.
以重复查询与候选换序审计 LLM judge 的位置偏差、稳定性与偏好方向。
why: It adds an auditable reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: contamination, verifier/reward failure, reward hacking, or evaluator reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM judges make evaluation scalable, but may select an answer because it is shown first or last rather than because it is better. Existing reports mostly test pairwise order swaps and do not separate systematic bias from sampling noise, leaving benchmark users unable to diagnose a judge.

This paper performs a systematic audit of position bias in pairwise and list-wise judging. It turns repeated prompts and candidate-order permutations into measurable reliability signals, then studies which judges, candidates, and tasks are associated with the failure.

自动评测的 LLM judge 能降低人工成本，却可能因答案排在首位或末位而选择它，而非依据内容质量作判断。既有研究多停留在成对换序，且难以区分系统性偏差与随机采样波动，使基准使用者无法诊断某个 judge 是否可靠。

本文系统审计成对与列表式评判中的位置偏差：把重复提问和候选答案换序转为可量化的可靠性信号，再分析 judge、候选模型和任务哪些因素与该失效相关。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The core contribution is an audit surface for LLM-as-a-Judge: repetition stability (RS), position consistency (PC), and preference fairness (PF) jointly distinguish random variation, order sensitivity, and systematic primacy/recency preference. Rather than releasing a new training dataset, the paper applies this measurement protocol to MTBench and DevBench and uses agreement patterns to identify hard-to-judge instances. No official downloadable dataset was located; the paper uses public benchmarks and reports an anonymous reproducibility repository in its appendix.

核心贡献是一个检验 LLM judge 比较选择能否经受重复调用与候选换序的评测面。偏好公平性在常用一致性之外记录不公平偏好的方向；重复稳定性则检查表面偏差是否只是随机波动。

论文分析已完成的 judgments，而非发布新的训练数据。它把提示词顺序、judge 家族、候选质量差、输出长度和任务特征作为审计变量；已找到正式论文与复现代码入口，但未找到官方可下载数据集。

实践中，这三个指标对应互补决策：先以稳定性排除不应解释的随机输出，再量化选定 judge 在换序后能否保留胜者，最后识别不一致选择是否系统偏向前位或后位。它把可靠性契约显式化，却不宣称自动评测因此成为语义真值。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Assemble evaluation records. The authors use MT-Bench and DevBench tasks, candidate-model answers, and 15 LLM judges; pairwise experiments use two candidates and list-wise experiments permute three candidates.
  1. Repeat and permute judgments. Each judge sees original and swapped candidate orders, with repeated calls. The output is a choice label; no verifier accepts or rejects an answer, because the object under audit is the judge's behavior.
  1. Compute audit metrics. Repetition stability measures whether repeated calls agree; position consistency checks whether the same candidate wins after reordering; preference fairness classifies consistent, primacy, and recency preferences.
  1. Analyze correlates and agreement. Bidirectional stepwise regression with AIC tests judge family, candidate quality gap, lengths, and task variables. The study reports post-hoc analyses, API-based runs costing about USD 3,000, and does not disclose all proprietary model internals.

1. 构建评测记录。作者使用 MT-Bench、DevBench 的任务和候选模型答案，并调用 15 个 LLM judge；成对设置含两个候选，列表式设置对三个候选做排列。
  1. 重复并换序评判。每个 judge 分别看到原始和交换后的候选顺序，并重复调用。输出为选择标签；这里没有筛掉答案的 verifier，因为审计对象是 judge 行为。
  1. 计算审计指标。重复稳定性衡量重复调用是否一致；位置一致性检验换序后是否仍由同一候选胜出；偏好公平性区分一致、首位偏好和末位偏好。
  1. 分析关联与一致性。作者用 AIC 双向逐步回归检验 judge 家族、候选质量差、长度和任务变量。分析为事后进行，API 实验约花费 3,000 美元，专有模型内部细节未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim: position bias measured by this protocol is systematic rather than random. The controlled evaluation covers 15 judges, MT-Bench and DevBench, 22 tasks, roughly 40 candidate-generating models, and more than 150,000 judgment instances.

In Table 2 and the main findings, capable judges generally have repetition stability above 0.85; Claude-3.5-Sonnet, GPT-4, and Llama-3.3-70B are above 0.95 on both benchmarks. Regression identifies judge series, candidate identity/quality gap, and task category as significant predictors; prompt length is weakly related while quality gap is strongly related. This supports auditing a chosen judge under the intended task distribution, not a universal bias ranking.

主张：该协议测到的位置偏差是系统性的，而非随机噪声。受控评测覆盖 15 个 judge、MT-Bench 与 DevBench 的 22 个任务、约 40 个候选生成模型，以及超过 150,000 个 judgment 实例。

表 2 与主要发现显示，有能力的 judge 的重复稳定性通常高于 0.85；Claude-3.5-Sonnet、GPT-4 和 Llama-3.3-70B 在两个 benchmark 上均高于 0.95。回归认为 judge 系列、候选身份或质量差和任务类别显著相关；提示词长度关系较弱，质量差关系较强。因此应针对目标任务分布审计所选 judge，不能把结果当作通用偏差排名。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior LLM-as-a-Judge audits commonly use an order swap and position consistency in pairwise comparisons, sometimes treating inconsistent outputs as ties. This paper does not introduce another judge or a debiasing algorithm; it changes the audit object from a single consistency score to a repeated, directional analysis that separates instability from primacy/recency preference and extends the setting to list-wise comparison.

That distinction makes the output useful for failure analysis: a low consistency score and a stable but directional preference are different operational risks. The contribution is an exploratory diagnostic framework, not evidence that the metrics themselves eliminate bias.

已有 LLM-as-a-Judge 审计常在成对比较中交换顺序并计算位置一致性，有时把不一致输出视为平局。本文并未提出新 judge 或去偏算法；它把审计对象从单一一致性分数改为可重复、带方向的分析，区分不稳定性与首位或末位偏好，并扩展到列表式比较。

这一区分使输出可用于故障分析：低一致性与稳定却有方向性的偏好是不同的运行风险。贡献是探索性诊断框架，而非证明这些指标能消除偏差。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors evaluate 12 commercial judges in pairwise settings, four in list-wise settings with only three candidates, and three Llama models; more models, prompting strategies, tasks, and larger candidate pools could change the conclusions. Reuse should therefore rerun the protocol on the intended model, prompt, and list size.

Closed-model architecture and parameter information are unavailable, so judge-level effects are approximated by model family. The analysis is post hoc and studies bias rather than mitigation; before using it as a release gate, define a response policy for low fairness or consistency and test it prospectively.

作者在成对设置中评估 12 个商业 judge，在仅含三个候选的列表式设置中评估 4 个，并仅纳入 3 个 Llama 模型；更多模型、提示词策略、任务和候选池可能改变结论。复用时应在目标模型、提示词和列表规模上重跑协议。

闭源模型的结构和参数不可得，因此 judge 层因素以模型家族近似。分析是事后进行且只研究偏差、不缓解偏差；若把它用作发布门槛，应先定义低公平性或低一致性的处置规则并做前瞻测试。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For an evaluation owner selecting an LLM judge, take a representative prompt–candidate set, run original and permuted orders repeatedly, and report RS, PC, and PF by task. The output is a judge audit table that can decide whether to randomize order, aggregate multiple calls, or exclude a judge from a task slice.

For benchmark maintainers, use inter-judge agreement to identify easy and contentious items before curating a test set. Do not use this protocol as an answer-correctness verifier or assume its thresholds transfer to generation tasks, new prompt templates, or larger list-wise rankings without a local calibration study.

若你负责选择 LLM judge，可准备有代表性的提示词—候选集合，对原始与换序后的输入重复评判，并按任务报告 RS、PC、PF。输出是 judge 审计表，可据此决定是否随机化顺序、聚合多次调用，或在某个任务切片中停用该 judge。

若你维护 benchmark，可用多 judge 一致性识别易判与有争议的样本，再调整测试集。不要把该协议当作答案正确性的 verifier，也不要未经本地校准就把阈值迁移到生成任务、新提示词模板或更大的列表式排序。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: it audits order sensitivity in LLM-as-a-Judge rather than training a better judge.
  2. Handle: repeat original and swapped prompts, then separate repetition stability, position consistency, and preference fairness.
  3. Artifact: proceedings paper and reproduction-code link exist; no official downloadable audit dataset was identified.
  4. Evidence anchor: 15 judges and over 150,000 instances; capable judges usually have RS >0.85, but bias varies by judge, task, and quality gap.
  5. Reuse decision: fit for a local judge audit; first rerun it on the target prompt and candidate pool, because it does not prescribe mitigation.

1. 一句话定位：它审计 LLM-as-a-Judge 的顺序敏感性，而非训练更强的 judge。
  2. 方法抓手：重复原始与交换后的提示词，再区分重复稳定性、位置一致性和偏好公平性。
  3. 数据或 Artifact 抓手：已有正式论文和复现代码入口；未找到官方可下载审计数据集。
  4. 证据锚点：15 个 judge、超过 150,000 个实例；有能力的 judge 通常 RS >0.85，但偏差随 judge、任务和质量差变化。
  5. 复用决定：适合做本地 judge 审计；先在目标提示词和候选池上重跑，因为论文不提供缓解方案。
